english.title: Fail to give required notice of arrival of consignment of animal / animal products to border control post

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: trade in animals and related products regulations 2011

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the person responsible for a consignment, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ANIMALS / PRODUCTS..), failed to notify its arrival to the border control post within at least

(A)_[one working day before it was due to arrive]_
(B)_[four hours before it was due to arrive, in the case where evidence of a logistical constraint which prevented notification of at least one working day, had been provided]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 14(1), 39 and 42 of the Trade in Animals and Related Products Regulations 2011.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being the person responsible for a consignment of animals / products specified in Commission Decision 2007/275/EC
failed to notify its arrival to the border control post
at least one day before the consignment was due to arrive / at least four hours before the consignment was due to arrive

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
